name: Migrate a WordPress, Elementor or Shopify site to Next.js with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Migrate a site to Next.js

Rebuilds the pages of a live site (WordPress/Elementor, Shopify, Webflow, anything public) as a Next.js + Tailwind project, section by section, in page order. Download the zip, run `npm install` and `npm run dev`.

**Setup**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key at https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding and add it as a **MiroMiro API** credential on both MiroMiro nodes.
2. List the pages in **Pages to migrate** with the route each should become.
3. Run it and download the zip from **Zip the project**.

**Cost:** 25 credits per section, so a typical page of 6-10 sections is 150-250 credits.

**Review before launch:** text and images belong to the source site unless it is yours; menus, sliders, forms and carts arrive as static markup; load the fonts and move the images into /public.
